criteria.reason: GET/PUT /api/user and follow/unfollow all call requireSessionUser; a user can only update their own record (the session's user). Public profile GET is intentionally anonymous.
Session resolved via the httpOnly-cookie auth library (inherited); password re-hash on update uses bcrypt.
All queries via Sequelize where-clause objects; no raw SQL.
No new secret/crypto handling in this story. Excluded.
Errors mapped to the Conduit envelope; no verbose disclosure.
Self-follow prevented (ValidationError); follow/unfollow idempotent — the two threat-model controls this story's design requires are present.
Every handler try/catches and maps to the error envelope; no leak.
